papers.title: A Survey of Large Language Models for Graphs
papers.note: Organizes graph–LLM methods into four integration paradigms and discusses their strengths and limitations.

papers.title: Large Language Models on Graphs: A Comprehensive Survey
papers.note: Surveys graph-enhanced LLMs and LLM-enhanced graph learning under a unified framework.

papers.title: A Survey of Graph Meets Large Language Model: Progress and Future Directions
papers.note: Reviews representative graph–LLM architectures, training strategies, and graph-task applications.

papers.title: Large Language Models Meet Graph Neural Networks: A Perspective of Graph Mining
papers.note: Frames the area as GNN-driving-LLM, LLM-driving-GNN, and co-driving approaches from a graph-mining perspective.

papers.title: Large Language Models Meet Text-Attributed Graphs: A Survey of Integration Frameworks and Applications
papers.note: Focuses on orchestration patterns and applications for LLM integration with text-attributed graphs.

papers.title: Can Language Models Solve Graph Problems in Natural Language?
papers.note: Benchmarks language models on graph problems expressed in natural language.

papers.title: GLBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Graph with Large Language Models
papers.note: Standardizes data splits and evaluation for representative LLM-based node-classification methods.

papers.title: Can Large Language Models Analyze Graphs like Professionals? A Benchmark, Datasets and Models
papers.note: Evaluates tool-using LLMs on professional graph-analysis workflows and large graphs.

papers.title: GraphArena: Evaluating and Exploring Large Language Models on Graph Computation
papers.note: Studies LLM graph-computation capability across task difficulty, prompting, and graph scale.

papers.title: How Do Large Language Models Understand Graph Patterns? A Benchmark for Graph Pattern Comprehension
papers.note: Evaluates graph-pattern recognition and autonomous pattern discovery by LLMs.

papers.title: When Do LLMs Help With Node Classification? A Comprehensive Analysis
papers.note: Compares LLM-based node classifiers across datasets, learning paradigms, homophily, model size, and prompts.

papers.title: GraphGPT: Graph Instruction Tuning for Large Language Models
papers.note: Aligns graph representations with an LLM through graph instruction tuning.

papers.title: LLaGA: Large Language and Graph Assistant
papers.note: Maps graph structures into a language-model token space for transferable graph instruction following.

papers.title: HiGPT: Heterogeneous Graph Language Model
papers.note: Extends graph-language alignment and instruction tuning to heterogeneous graphs.

papers.title: ZeroG: Investigating Cross-dataset Zero-shot Transferability in Graphs
papers.note: Studies cross-dataset zero-shot transfer using language-aligned graph representations and task descriptions.

papers.title: GraphTranslator: Aligning Graph Model to Large Language Model for Open-ended Tasks
papers.note: Connects a pretrained graph encoder to an LLM for open-ended graph tasks.

papers.title: Graph-Oriented Instruction Tuning of Large Language Models for Generic Graph Mining
papers.note: Instruction-tunes one language model across node-, link-, and graph-level mining tasks.

papers.title: GraspLLM: Towards Zero-Shot Generalization on Text-Attributed Graphs with LLMs
papers.note: Combines motif-aware structural learning with LLM alignment for cross-dataset and cross-task zero-shot transfer.

papers.title: Harnessing Explanations: LLM-to-LM Interpreter for Enhanced Text-Attributed Graph Representation Learning
papers.note: Uses LLM-generated explanations as additional features for text-attributed graph learning.

papers.title: Can GNN Be Good Adapter for LLMs?
papers.note: Uses a GNN as an efficient structural adapter for an LLM on text-attributed graphs.

papers.title: GraphEdit: Large Language Models for Graph Structure Learning
papers.note: Uses LLM knowledge to edit noisy text-attributed graph structures before downstream learning.

papers.title: LOGIN: A Large Language Model Consulted Graph Neural Network Training Framework
papers.note: Queries an LLM selectively during GNN training to improve labels and supervision under a limited budget.

papers.title: GAugLLM: Improving Graph Contrastive Learning for Text-Attributed Graphs with Large Language Models
papers.note: Uses LLM-derived semantic signals to construct graph augmentations for contrastive learning.

papers.title: Large Language Model Guided Graph Clustering
papers.note: Selectively queries an LLM for noisy feedback and uses it to refine GNN-based clustering on text-attributed graphs.

papers.title: MARK: Multi-agent Collaboration with Ranking Guidance for Text-attributed Graph Clustering
papers.note: Coordinates concept, generation, and inference agents to create ranking supervision for uncertain nodes.

papers.title: D2CS - Documents Graph Clustering using LLM supervision
papers.note: Iteratively updates edges in a document-similarity graph using LLM assessments of cluster coherence.

papers.title: Minority-aware Semantic Alignment via Knowledge Enhancement for Long-tailed Graph Clustering
papers.note: Uses LLM knowledge to produce balanced mixed groups with emphasis on minority classes; the public paper URL was pending at snapshot time.

papers.title: Node Role-Guided LLMs for Dynamic Graph Clustering
papers.note: Uses semantic node-role prototypes and hierarchical LLM reasoning for interpretable dynamic graph clustering.

papers.title: When Noisy Labels Meet Class Imbalance on Graphs: A Graph Augmentation Method with LLM and Pseudo Label
papers.note: Uses LLM-generated minority nodes and dynamic pseudo-labeling for node classification with class imbalance and noisy labels.

papers.title: UniS2A: Unified Semantic and Structural Augmentation for Text-Attributed Graphs with Large Language Models
papers.note: Integrates LLM semantic reasoning with feature- and structure-level augmentation for text-attributed graphs.
